notes: The proof unjustifiably strengthens population sex balance and within-family independence to a common fair-coin law. Consider two two-child families (X,Y) and (1-X,1-Y), where X,Y are independent Bernoulli(3/4) male indicators. Exactly half the population is male, and sexes are independent within each family, yet E[brothers|female]=3/8 and E[brothers|male]=5/8. Replicating these blocks gives a large population. The draft proves equality only under its additional assumption.
